title: Is This the Ultimate Winter Sun Destination?
abstract: Puerto Escondido, set on a stunning sweep of Mexico’s Pacific Coast, draws both big-wave surfers and starchitects.

title: 24 Hours in Jeddah With an Airline Pilot
abstract: On a stopover in Saudi Arabia, the writer strolls along the corniche, lingers over coffee and explores the historic heart of this city on the Red Sea.
